title: Drunk Entitled Woman Crashes Her Car And Tries To Deny It
description:
On April 20, 2022, officers responded to a hit-and-run crash. The suspect’s vehicle was found in a severely damaged condition after crashing into the guard rails. Here's what happened next. The woman was very intoxicated and was going to ramble on about nonsense. The woman's truck was towed away, and she was taken to the police station for the rest of the procedures. The female was charged with the following offences - Aggravated DUI, Immediate notice of accidents, Duty upon striking fixtures or other properties upon a highway, Duty to give information and render aid, Driving on roadways laned for traffic, Resisting arrest and Accidents involving damage to vehicle
